scope: Frozen-state postprocessed original native equations, 0..200us active saved states and actual native t0 source primitives. No trajectory recomputation, native edit, or core edit.
law_model_effect_meaning: Candidate constitutive law with production constants minus original native force at identical realized t0 state/native primitives. It contains declared drag substitution and thermophoresis omission; small constant differences are separately identified.
field_transfer_effect_meaning: Same candidate law and production constants at identical native t0 states, candidate P1 primitive evaluation minus direct native primitive evaluation.

native_Waldmann_PPR_binding.heat_flux_SI_derivation: Native accepted κ [W/(m K)] times native accepted pprint temperature gradient [K/m]; original isotropic κ diagonal, zero cross terms. Direct heatflux bracket API unit was blank and is not silently treated as an accepted readback.

source_Brownian_velocity_and_diffusion_s.impulse_meaning: sqrt(native Brownian force variance times dt * 10us)/native mass. Unattenuated frozen-force impulse coefficient scale, not native historical RK draws, drag-filtered velocity, or OU endpoint variance.
source_Brownian_velocity_and_diffusion_s.scope: Native source-point FDT coefficient scales only; not inhomogeneous chamber trajectory/arrival prediction, uncertainty band, or recovered native random draws.

native_Waldmann_PPR_binding.heat_flux_SI_derivation: Native accepted κ [W/(m K)] times native accepted pprint temperature gradient [K/m]; original isotropic κ diagonal, zero cross terms. Direct heatflux bracket API unit was blank and is not silently treated as an accepted readback.

source_Brownian_velocity_and_diffusion_s.impulse_meaning: sqrt(native Brownian force variance times dt * 10us)/native mass. Unattenuated frozen-force impulse coefficient scale, not native historical RK draws, drag-filtered velocity, or OU endpoint variance.
source_Brownian_velocity_and_diffusion_s.scope: Native source-point FDT coefficient scales only; not inhomogeneous chamber trajectory/arrival prediction, uncertainty band, or recovered native random draws.

limits: No historical integrator-stage or stochastic draw reconstruction; native saved-time randomnormal and timestep are postprocessed observations.
A same-source equation replay PASS does not qualify full native-FE trajectory reproduction or the extrapolated physical model.
DEP gradients, vorticity and plasma primitives are native source-point samples; derivatives and field transfer away from these points are not certified.
Whole-population original linear Epstein/Waldmann remains outside accepted production applicability; the audit does not change selectors or run a substituted original trajectory.
Candidate source law evaluations are frozen pure formulas, not a second trajectory engine or the historical numerical proposal.
